spec.description: Proxy host health: kernel TCP signals, nginx stream sessions, xray traffic and observatory
Veles observatory probe via the dynamic reverse outbound: 1 = healthy, 0 = unhealthy. No series means the outbound or telemetry is absent, not that it is healthy; this is not a connection count.
spec.title: Reverse path probe (Veles)

spec.description: Xray outbound bytes per second: Veles reverse-buyan-out, Buyan reverse-veles-client (link) and reverse-public-out (public egress). Up/down are relative to each outbound; no traffic is not proof that the link is down.
spec.title: Reverse traffic by outbound
